input.justification:
The XPath expression is built from the variable `bar`. Although `bar` is first assigned from the tainted cookie-derived `param` via `map51005.get("keyB-51005")`, it is immediately overwritten by the next line `bar = (String) map51005.get("keyA-51005");`, which returns the constant string "a_Value" that was put into the map earlier. Therefore the value actually used in the XPath expression (`/Employees/Employee[@emplid='" + bar + "']`) is always the hard-coded "a_Value" and never reflects the user-supplied cookie value. The taint flow is broken before reaching the XPath sink, so the query cannot be manipulated by user input despite CodeQL flagging a path through the HashMap.</justification>
